**Türkiye: how applications changed.** The extract records 935,152 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 150,996 in 2023, compared with 94,965 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 166% higher than in 2019 (35,642). Applications in 2025 were 16% lower than in 2024 (113,574). In 2025, the leading destinations were Germany (59,455; 63%), France (12,664; 13%), Belgium (2,941; 3.1%). Germany received 63% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 32% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 17%, across 103,195 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 22% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 5.5 percentage points lower than in 2024 (23%).
